backup.restore_point: PENDING - name the backup set taken immediately before this apply
backup.production_rule: Expand only: nine new functions (one RPC, one storage-policy helper, seven internal helpers) and one new storage.objects SELECT policy on the guest-id-photos bucket. No table, column, grant or data change; the three existing guest-id-photos policies (manage read, write, delete) are untouched. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup, re-read the clock, then fill both. Take a fresh backup if the one named is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: functions_exist_definer_empty_search_path

forward_verification.name: payload_code_never_selects_money_or_contact_columns
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname in ('staff_home_v1','staff_guest_card_v1','staff_current_next_stays_v1') and p.prosrc ~* '(guest_phone|guest_email|phone_e164|email_normalized|total_amount|deposit_amount|guest_paid|host_payout|payout_amount|raw_description|raw_summary|id_number|birthday|address)')

forward_verification.name: cleaner_payload_has_no_money_phone_or_email_shape
forward_verification.query: with c as (select set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', (select p.user_id::text from public.staff_access_profiles p join public.staff_property_access a on a.user_id = p.user_id and a.property_id = '6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd' where p.role = 'cleaner' and p.disabled_at is null order by p.user_id limit 1), 'role', 'authenticated', 'aal', 'aal1', 'iat', extract(epoch from now())::bigint)::text, true) cfg) select coalesce(regexp_replace(public.staff_home_v1(case when length(c.cfg) > 0 then '6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd'::uuid end)::text, '"(uid|property_id|id_photo_path)": "[^"]*"', '', 'g') !~* '(amount|deposit|total|phone|email|\+639|[0-9]{10}|(\+?63|0)9([ .-]*[0-9]){9}|[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}|\mP\s*[0-9]|php|pesos|piso)', false) from c

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Apply supabase/rollbacks/20261005_staff_home_v1.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: it drops the storage policy, the RPC and the eight helpers. Nothing else changed. Roll the Cascade Staff app back or take it offline first, or its home shows an error banner.

feature_flags.name: sql_then_app
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this release BEFORE the Cascade Staff repo is pushed to GitHub Pages: the app calls staff_home_v1 on every open and shows an error banner until the function exists.

compatibility.rehearsal: NOT RUN - the orchestrator rehearses this release (migration-rehearsal-on-host.sh) and runs pgTAP staff_home_v1.sql (36 tests) before filling this field.
compatibility.evidence: Read-only against production on 2026-10-05: staff_home_v1 and the seven helpers absent; current_staff_authorized and staff_access_allowed live bodies read (cleaner has read_operations and submit_cleaning, maintenance has read_operations); guest-id-photos policies are manage_operations only; 40 of 41 confirmed stays since 2026-05-01 resolve to a guest by link, by direct inquiry or by unique dates; guest_profile_details.stay_preferences is the notes column; guest_companions.id_photo_path holds <companion id>/<uuid>.jpg.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty or still the PENDING placeholder
the rehearsal has not run the pgTAP suite green on this commit
the Cascade Staff repo is pushed before this release is applied
